Path: business objects, records and views | records-forms.list-view-capabilities | P2

## Triage: first grade (blocked on two open PRs) — `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:blocked` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` and `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (the load effects harvest `$select` operands from `conditionalFormatting` / `rowActionDefs` / `bulkActionDefs`, and the grid's `$searchFields` from `searchableFields`, outside their dependency lists) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: a rule added to a mounted grid or list never fetches its operand (measured: `$select` stays `[['id','name']]` against a fresh mount's `[['id','name','industry']]`). It is the fetch-effect-keys family, whose closure card objectui#10664 is in flight (PR objectui#10688). A card in flight is never folded into, so this is its own card, at objectui#10664's grade (p3). The two files are under open PRs, so it waits on them.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T18:51Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card and its full thread, and objectui `origin/main`.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#10278
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#10643

Execution note: PR objectui#10688's shape. Key each input the query reads by content (a stable string key), never by identity. Pin a rule added to a mounted grid and a mounted list re-reading with its operand in `$select`, with an equal re-render as the no-refetch control. It is released when both named PRs merge or close.
